αἴρω: to take up, raise, lift up
βλάπτω: to disable, hinder (Hom.); to harm, damage
βουλεύω: to take counsel, deliberate, concert measures
δηλέομαι: to hurt, do a mischief to
διαπράσσω: to pass over; bring about, accomplish
δύναμαι: to be able, capable, strong enough
εἴρω: to fasten together in rows, to string
θάπτω: to bury, to honour with funeral rites
κακόω: to treat ill, maltreat, afflict, distress
καταξενόομαι: to be received as a guest
κεῖμαι: to lie; to have been set/put (as perf. pass. of τίθημι)
κλίνω: to make to bend, slope; recline
κονίω: to make dusty, cover with clouds of dust
κρίνω: to pick out, choose, judge, determine
κτάομαι: to procure for oneself, to get, gain, acquire
λέγω: to say, tell, speak; epic and arch.: pick, gather
λανθάνω: to escape notice, to be unknown, unseen, unnoticed
ξενόω: to make one’s friend and guest
πάλλω: to poise, shake, sway, leap, cast lots
παρίημι: to pass over, let go, relax, yield, allow
παραμελέω: to pass by and disregard, to be disregardful of
πείθω: to prevail upon, win over, persuade
πελάζω: to approach, come near, draw near
πονέω: to work hard, do work, suffer toil
πόρω: pres. not attested; aor. to furnish, offer; perf. it is fated
στέλλω: to set in order, to arrange, array, equip, make ready
τετίημαι: to be sorrowful, to sorrow, mourn
τεχνάομαι: to make by art, to execute skilfully
τεύχω: to make ready, make, build, work
τιμάω: to honor; to value something at a price (gen.)
τιμωρέω: to seek, exact vengeance; help to retaliate
τρέφω: to nourish, rear, maintain; congeal, curdle
φαίνω: to bring to light, make to appear
φεύγω: to flee, take flight, run away
φοβέω: to put to flight, to terrify; mid. to fear
φυλάσσω: to keep watch and ward, keep guard
ἀνίημι: to send up; let go, abate
ἀσκέω: (prose) exercise, train (poetry) to work curiously, form by art, fashion, revere
ἐκθεάομαι: to see out, see to the end
ἐκκηρύσσω: to proclaim by voice of herald
ἐκπλήσσω: (to knock out); to astound, shock, amaze
ἐμποδίζω: to put the feet in bonds, to fetter
ἐξαρτύω: to get ready, equip thoroughly, fit out
ἐξεργάζομαι: to work out, make completely, finish off, bring to perfection
ἐπαπειλέω: to hold out as a threat to
ἐπικλίνω: to put to; bend towards, lean upon
ἐπισεύω: to put in motion against, set upon
ἐπισκιάζω: to throw a shade upon, overshadow
ἐπιστέλλω: to send to, send as a message
ἐπονομάζω: to give a surname: to name
ἱδρύω: to make to sit down, to seat
ἱκνέομαι: to come, reach, approach; to supplicate, beseech; to befit
ὁπλίζω: to equip, make ready; to arm
ὠφελέω: to help, aid, assist, to be of use
